body:

Marc Lussi (Developer Program)

Sep 18, 2024, 13:29 GMT+2

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for being interested in becoming a part of our Garmin Connect Developer Program.
We appreciate the trust you put in us, our products, and our services.

All access requests to our data exchange solutions undergo a rigorous review process before they are granted.

Unfortunately, we cannot process your request as it was requested by a non-personalized / generic email address.

A personalized email address as the main contact and legal representative is a basic requirement for access.
Please respond to this ticket and provide a non-generic email address such as
(firstname.lastname@domain.xyz) in order to allow us to verify your request.

If we don´t hear from you within three business days, your request will be automatically rejected.


Best Regards / Freundliche Grüße / Cordialement
Marc Lussi
Garmin Connect Partner Services

Reminder:
Please also do not forget to add your team members to the portal by clicking on your company name and "members" after your first login.
Support for unverified persons will not be provided and sharing access/documentation may result in your apps/access being revoked.
[16L34N-12E6D]

subject: Avicenna Research; SDK / Health Contact Form, Ticket: 158833
body:
Dear Marc,

I hope this email finds you well.

Thank you for the information. I would like to inform you that our team has been listed under the name "Ethica Data Services Inc." in the Garmin portal. However, as part of our rebranding, we would like to update this to "Avicenna Research". Previously, we operated under the name Ethica Data.

Please designate mohammad@avicennaresearch.com as the primary contact and legal representative, and omid.dolatkia@avicennaresearch.com as the technical lead for testing and integration of the Garmin Health SDK.

Your assistance is greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Omid Dolatkia
Software Engineer | Avicenna Research
--
